shortlist.format: One unbroken orbiting/flying camera move around a subject; mid-move, without a cut, the object in frame changes (car parts swap, subject/object replace) — the transformation reads as magic because the camera never stops.
Seedance showcase: single continuous shot, no cut, used purely to prove model consistency across a transformation.
A static-feeling frame suddenly gains motion/energy and a dramatic reveal happens within it — 'you wouldn't believe this started as one picture'.
'Storm' trend — face/subject swap while the original clip's camera movement, pacing and cuts are kept identical.
Aifilmmaking short with a comic mid-shot twist/gag revealed without a cut.

note: Borrowed only the camera-move/no-cut-transformation format, not any shot, audio, people or brand from the source video.
